description: Documents feature (Firebase Storage per user) plus the ExploreScreen entry point and the Kiro spec copy into the branch. Add the useUserDocuments hook, a pure DocumentsScreen, the /documents route wrapper, and the ExploreScreen folder+logout header affordances wired through explore.tsx; then copy .kiro/specs/elder from the MAIN tree into the worktree and edit it to reflect the prototype->Firebase-product shift with Wave 1 marked. files.ts exists from FEAT-001 and the documents route is already registered in _layout.tsx from FEAT-002. Depends on FEAT-002 (needs account.uid, logout, and the registered route). Independent of FEAT-003/004/005.
steps: Create src/hooks/useUserDocuments.ts (outside src/app; the ONLY place importing the pickers and files.ts): owns documents, loading, uploading, error; exposes pickAndUploadFile() (expo-document-picker getDocumentAsync), pickAndUploadImage() (expo-image-picker launchImageLibraryAsync), and remove(fullPath). A user cancel (result.canceled / empty assets) is a no-op; a missing name falls back to the uri's last path segment. On upload/list/delete failure set error (no crash) and keep the list consistent. Verify the picker APIs against https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/sdk/document-picker and .../sdk/imagepicker before coding (they changed across SDKs; getDocumentAsync returns { canceled, assets:[{uri,name,mimeType,size}] }, launchImageLibraryAsync returns { canceled, assets:[{uri,fileName,mimeType,fileSize}] }).

Create src/screens/DocumentsScreen.tsx (pure, no Firebase/picker import) in the existing visual language: a list of documents (name + optional size/type), two upload actions ('Escolher arquivo' / 'Escolher foto'), per-item delete, and loading/empty/error states. Props: { documents, loading, uploading, errorMessage, onPickFile, onPickImage, onDelete(fullPath), onBack, topInset?, bottomInset? }.

Create src/app/documents.tsx (route wrapper): holds useSafeAreaInsets + router, calls useUserDocuments (uid from useAccount), wires its state/actions to DocumentsScreen, onBack=()=>router.back(). The route name 'documents' is already in _layout.tsx's Stack (added in FEAT-002); if missing, add it.

Edit src/screens/ExploreScreen.tsx: add optional props onLogout?: ()=>void and onOpenDocuments?: ()=>void. Replace the bare <Logo size='sm' style={{...marginLeft:28, marginBottom:20}} /> with the header row from design.md: <View className='flex-row items-center justify-between px-7 mb-5'> containing the Logo (style width:80,height:24) and a right group with a MaterialIcons 'folder' Pressable (accessibilityLabel 'Meus documentos', onPress onOpenDocuments) and a MaterialIcons 'logout' Pressable (accessibilityLabel 'Sair', onPress onLogout), both navy #11375C, conditionally rendered. No new imports are needed (MaterialIcons/Pressable/View already imported). Do NOT add py-* padding. Leave FloatingNav untouched.

Edit src/app/explore.tsx: pass onLogout={async () => { await signOut() }} and onOpenDocuments={() => router.push('/documents')} (signOut from useAccount). On logout the observeAuth handler clears state and RootNavigator redirects to '/'.

Copy the Kiro spec from the MAIN tree into the worktree: create c:/Users/savio/OneDrive/Tier2/Elder/elder/.worktrees/firebase-core/.kiro/specs/elder/ containing the files from c:/Users/savio/OneDrive/Tier2/Elder/elder/.kiro/specs/elder/ (.config.kiro, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md), then EDIT the copied requirements.md/design.md/tasks.md so the spec reflects the prototype->Firebase-product shift with Wave 1 marked (real Firebase backend: Auth + Firestore + Storage; data now persists; catalog stays a local seed; Wave 2 reserves FCM/push). Do not edit the MAIN tree copy. Reading the MAIN tree is outside the worktree, so use a shell copy command (e.g. Copy-Item) for the files, then edit the copies in the worktree with the editor.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` and fix any errors.
acceptance_criteria: A logged-in user can pick a file (document picker or image) and upload it to users/{uid}/documents/ in Storage with a progress/state indication; cancel is a no-op (AC-21).

DocumentsScreen lists the current user's uploaded documents (AC-22) and lets the user delete one with the list reflecting the removal (AC-23); upload/delete failures surface a message without crashing (AC-24).

The documents entry point is the ExploreScreen folder header icon wired via onOpenDocuments -> router.push('/documents'); FloatingNav is unchanged (two items, 'explore'|'care' union); the logout icon calls signOut and returns to the login/root (AC-6).
DocumentsScreen is pure (no Firebase/picker import); picking/uploading lives only in useUserDocuments; the two-layer boundary holds (AC-25).
c:/Users/savio/.../\.worktrees/firebase-core/.kiro/specs/elder/ exists with the spec files edited to reflect the Firebase-product shift and Wave 1 marked, so the updated spec travels with the branch.
`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` both pass (AC-30).
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from the worktree root and confirm zero errors.
Run `npx expo lint` from the worktree root and confirm zero errors.

Confirm the worktree .kiro/specs/elder/ directory exists with the edited spec files, DocumentsScreen imports no Firebase/picker, and ExploreScreen's header row adds only the folder/logout icons with no palette/padding change.
findings: Implemented all FEAT-006 steps. Picker result shapes verified against the installed SDK 57 typings (expo-document-picker@57.0.3, expo-image-picker@57.0.20), which are authoritative over the client-rendered docs pages: getDocumentAsync -> { canceled, assets:[{ uri, name, size?, mimeType? }] }; launchImageLibraryAsync -> { canceled, assets:[{ uri, fileName?, fileSize?, mimeType? }] } (note the asset fields are fileName/fileSize, not name/size). Created src/hooks/useUserDocuments.ts (sole importer of the pickers + files.ts): owns documents/loading/uploading/error, exposes pickAndUploadFile/pickAndUploadImage/remove; cancel is a no-op (checks canceled + empty assets); missing name falls back to the uri's last segment; failures set error without crashing and remove() re-syncs via listDocuments on delete failure. The uid-change loading reset uses the render-time 'adjust state when a prop changes' pattern (mirrors useCareTasks) so the effect never calls setState synchronously (satisfies react-hooks/set-state-in-effect). Created pure src/screens/DocumentsScreen.tsx (no Firebase/picker import) with the two upload actions, per-item delete, and loading/empty/error states in the existing visual language. Created src/app/documents.tsx wrapper (insets + router + useAccount uid, onBack=router.back). Edited ExploreScreen: added optional onLogout/onOpenDocuments props and replaced the bare Logo with the design.md header row (folder + logout navy MaterialIcons, px-7/mb-5, no py-* padding, no new imports); FloatingNav untouched. Wired explore.tsx (onLogout=await signOut(), onOpenDocuments=router.push('/documents')). The documents route was already registered in _layout.tsx (FEAT-002). Copied .kiro/specs/elder from the MAIN tree into the worktree via Copy-Item and edited only the worktree copies (requirements.md/design.md/tasks.md) to reflect the prototype->Firebase-product shift with Wave 1 marked (Auth+Firestore+Storage, data persists, catalog stays a local seed, Wave 2 reserves FCM/push + Portal do Parceiro); MAIN tree copy untouched. Gates: `npx tsc --noEmit` zero errors; `npx expo lint` zero errors (one pre-existing exhaustive-deps WARNING in src/screens/DiscoverScreen.tsx, which FEAT-006 does not touch). Not verifiable here (per context.json): real upload+list in Expo Go and storageBucket correctness need a manual smoke test; tsc/lint passing does not prove runtime correctness.
